newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rate rises slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rate rises slightly at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government's 729-day development bonds, or Bondes, rose 0.11 percentage points to 1.41 percent above the one-month Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 729-day Bondes were assigned at 97.85283 pesos.
Demand for the bondes was 2.53 billion pesos, compared with the 700 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
